page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one column at the right, with two marginal notes in the left margin: "entrum." at the top, beside the first line, and "Conjugitur viri coelestis cum terrestri muliere." beside the line "und zu clarificirn." Below the text, the closing word "FINIS CABALÆ." and a woodcut ornament. Show-through text from the facing page runs along the right edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: entrum.Mittel-Centrum, so sich zwischen Oberste und Unterste gesetzt / und beyden Kräffte / als der rechte philosophische Magnet-Stein / in gezogen/und derselbigen Essentien Vollkommenheit zu sich genommen hat / andern Corpora damit zu erleuchten und zu clarificirn. Endlich ist ein Band der Ehelichen Pflicht / himmlischen Mannes mit der irdischen Frauen / welche mit solcher unzertrennlichen Liebe seynd verbunden und unzahlbaren Fruchtbarkeit begabet.
Note: Conjugitur viri coelestis cum terrestri muliere.

page.notes: The text is in Fraktur (black letter). The right edge of the text block is cropped, so the line ends are cut off and are shown only as far as they are visible; the cut-off words are not guessed. The marginal note "entrum." is partly cut off at the left, so it may be a fragment of "Centrum." The second marginal note is set in a different type, probably roman, and is placed beside the line "und zu clarificirn." The woodcut ornament below FINIS CABALÆ carries no text. Show-through from the facing page is ignored.
